The statement in the prompt represents the joint relative frequency (350=6% of all campers), which is mathematically accurate. The prompt lacks the conditional phrasing needed to make 'No' the correct answer, creating a mismatch between the stem and key.

G7 SM5e_G07_AS_Post_M05_T10_AK.pdf Page 4, Item 4 Yes Error. The explanation states that the events are complementary "because the sum of their probabilities equals 1." Having probabilities that sum to 1 is a necessary condition for complementary events, but not a sufficient definition on its own, because two non-disjoint (overlapping) events can also have probabilities that sum to 1. To accurately explain why the events are complementary, the response must state that the two events are mutually exclusive (they share no outcomes) and exhaustive (their union contains all outcomes of the sample space).
